horizon_response_source: Organisers (18.09.2026): correction starts after 0.5-2 h and there is no passport response time, therefore the conservative operational onset is 2 h. The observed 3-8 h window is a rare plateau window, not the onset. beta is the mean cumulative ARX response in that 3-8 h window; within the 3 h case horizon at most 0.66 of beta*dT is credited because the APC delivers 0.62-0.66 of the commanded T6 step by 3 h (FS = 0.66, F1 first stage on SELECT, research/response/t6/response_model.py, docs/response-model.md section 5); beyond the horizon (look-ahead) the full beta applies
flow_beta_note: F9 lags enter the ARX only as a control; no identified sustained flow effect (F9 vs F26 as flow tag changes beta by <0.002)
